# Security Policy

**PLEASE DON'T DISCLOSE SECURITY-RELATED ISSUES PUBLICLY.**

## Supported Versions

This package is pre-release and pinned to the MiniMailer **v1** API contract through
`minimailer/minimailer-php`. Only the latest release receives security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security-related issue in this Laravel transport, email
**hello@minimailer.app** rather than opening an issue. All security vulnerabilities will be
promptly addressed.

Please include:

- the package version, Laravel version and PHP version,
- a description of the issue and its impact,
- a reproduction case if you have one.

If the issue is in the underlying SDK (`minimailer/minimailer-php`) or in the MiniMailer
**API or service** rather than this transport, report it through the same address and say so —
the fix ships there, not here.
